rules.title: Guaranteed returns
rules.description: Communications may not promise, guarantee or assure a specific rate of return or investment outcome.

rules.title: Claims of no risk
rules.description: Communications may not state or imply that an investment is risk-free, safe from loss, or carries no market risk.

rules.title: Performance projections
rules.description: Communications may not predict or project future investment performance (e.g. 'will double', 'expect to earn 25%').

rules.title: Exaggerated or promissory claims
rules.description: Communications may not contain exaggerated, unwarranted, promissory or superlative claims ('can't lose', 'best investment ever', 'sure thing').

rules.title: Cherry-picked past performance
rules.description: Past performance figures must not be presented selectively or without the required time periods and context.

rules.title: Undisclosed testimonials
rules.description: Client testimonials or endorsements require disclosure of whether the person was compensated and any conflicts.

rules.title: Blanket suitability claims
rules.description: Products may not be described as suitable for all investors or recommended without regard to the client's profile.

rules.title: High-pressure urgency
rules.description: Communications should not use high-pressure or artificial-urgency sales tactics ('act now', 'only 24 hours left').

rules.title: Misleading fee claims
rules.description: Communications may not claim an investment or account has no fees or is free when fees or expenses apply.

rules.title: Denial of conflicts of interest
rules.description: Firms may not claim to have no conflicts of interest; material conflicts must be disclosed under Regulation Best Interest.
